name: Nagatoro Yuuki
source:
The protagonist of this story and Shouko's only son.  He has a calm and easygoing personality, like his mother, and does not take things too seriously. Therefore, he does not feel lonely even when his father is away, and spends his days peacefully.

His academic performance is middle of the class. He also plays sports as well as anyone else, but he is not outstanding in anything. His hobby is drawing illustrations, and he is quite good at it. In the future, he would like to become a illustrator.

When he visits illustration-related websites, he often sees erotic pictures because he is quite interested in sex.  He also has a very big dick.
